Introduction. The Hive is a boss which is only available via Console Commands.

Notes. • The Hive is immune to all damage types, it can be killed by hitting one of the two small red circles located near the top of its model.
• The Hive is a mixture of Drake and Gjall. Because it makes drake sounds and uses Gjall attacks.
